title: Three Silent Suspects
headline: THREE SILENT SUSPECTS
synopsis: A distro update swaps the login manager and Enter Gaming Mode fails silently, three ways. Sam and Glitch crack the case.
altText: Noir four-panel strip. Detective Sam clicks a button and nothing happens. A beetle named Glitch lists three suspects: wrong folder, dead session, deaf daemon. Sam restarts the display manager and gaming mode launches.
layout: four panels in a 2x2 grid, noir rain, one teal accent for the gaming mode glow

panels.scene: Rainy night. Sam, a trench-coated detective, jabs a glowing 'Enter Gaming Mode' button on a monitor. Nothing happens.
Sam and Glitch the beetle at a corkboard with three suspect photos: a folder, a ghost, an ear

dialogue.speaker: glitch
dialogue.text: Wrong folder. Dead session. Deaf daemon.

panels.scene: Sam stands over a sheepish line-up of three config files under a lamp

dialogue.speaker: sam
dialogue.text: Fail loudly. Then restart the daemon.

panels.scene: Gaming mode blazes to life in teal light; Glitch waves a tiny flag, Sam grins
